dwg_grips.st.len_bad: Type a length greater than zero
dwg_grips.st.len_none: This grip takes no typed length: drag it to the point
dwg_grips.st.len_dir: Move the cursor away from the fixed point to give the direction
dwg_grips.st.changed: The drawing changed during the drag: nothing was moved
dwg_grips.st.same: The grip is where it was: nothing changed
dwg_grips.st.gone: The picked primitive is gone: pick it again
dwg_grips.st.ring_arcs: This polyline has arcs: explode it to edit its vertices
dwg_grips.st.zero: A segment would have zero length there
dwg_grips.st.shared: Another closed polyline uses this segment: explode one of them first
dwg_grips.st.arc_ring: This arc is part of a closed polyline: explode it to edit the arc
dwg_grips.st.arc_flat: The three points are on one line: no arc passes through them
dwg_grips.st.no_vertex: Click a vertex grip of the picked polyline first
dwg_grips.st.vertex_last: A line keeps its two ends: delete the whole line instead
dwg_grips.st.vertex_ring: A closed polyline keeps at least three vertices
